## 5-Day High-Protein, Low-Carb Vegetarian Meal Plan

This meal plan offers a variety of high-protein, low-carb vegetarian options designed to be budget-friendly for one person, aiming for approximately $10 per day on groceries. It focuses on affordable staples like eggs, tofu, tempeh, lentils, and a wide array of non-starchy vegetables.

## Your Daily Meal Schedule

### Day 1
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Breakfast:** Tofu Scramble with Spinach & Mushrooms
  - *Details:* Crumbled tofu sautéed with spinach, sliced mushrooms, and a pinch of turmeric for color.
- **Lunch:** Large Mixed Green Salad with Hard-Boiled Eggs & Chickpeas
  - *Details:* Mixed greens, 2 hard-boiled eggs, 1/4 cup chickpeas, cucumber, bell peppers, and a simple olive oil & vinegar dressing.
- **Dinner:** Tofu & Broccoli Stir-fry with Cauliflower Rice
  - *Details:* Cubed firm tofu and broccoli florets stir-fried in a low-sodium soy sauce/tamari and ginger sauce, served over riced cauliflower.

- **Dinner:** Lentil & Mushroom "Meatballs" with Zucchini Noodles
  - *Details:* Lentil and mushroom-based "meatballs" (made with oats/flax for binding) served with spiralized zucchini noodles and a low-sugar marinara sauce.

## Budget-Friendly Shopping & Prep Tips

Achieving a $10/day grocery budget for high-protein, low-carb vegetarian meals requires strategic shopping and meal prep.
- **Buy in Bulk:** Purchase staples like dried lentils, tofu, tempeh, frozen vegetables, and larger containers of Greek yogurt or cottage cheese when on sale.
- **Seasonal Produce:** Opt for vegetables that are in season, as they are often cheaper and fresher.
- **Meal Prep:** Dedicate time once or twice a week to chop vegetables, cook grains (like lentils), or prepare components for several meals.
- **Pantry Staples:** Stock up on essential spices, oils, vinegars, and low-sodium soy sauce/tamari to enhance flavors without added cost.
- **Minimize Waste:** Utilize leftovers for lunches to prevent food waste and save money.
